mapper.select: SELECT level_code AS levelCode, COUNT(*) AS memberCount FROM t_member WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY level_code ORDER BY level_code
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM t_consume_order WHERE pay_time >= #{start} AND pay_time <= #{end} AND order_status IN (1, 2) AND is_deleted = 0 AND member_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_consume_order WHERE pay_time >= #{start} AND pay_time <= #{end} AND order_status IN (1, 2) AND member_id IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS statDate, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN benefit_type = 1 THEN member_id END) AS newParticipants, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN benefit_type = 2 THEN member_id END) AS newConversions, COALESCE(SUM(order_amount), 0) AS orderAmount FROM t_benefit_use_log WHERE benefit_id = #{activityId} AND use_status IN (1, 2) AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY statDate ASC

SELECT m.level_code AS levelCode, COUNT(DISTINCT bul.member_id) AS participantCount FROM t_benefit_use_log bul LEFT JOIN t_member m ON bul.member_id = m.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 WHERE bul.benefit_id = #{activityId} AND bul.benefit_type = 1 AND bul.use_status IN (1, 2) AND bul.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.level_code ORDER BY m.level_code

SELECT ct.id AS templateId, ct.coupon_name AS couponName, COALESCE(COUNT(ci.id), 0) AS issuedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ci.coupon_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS usedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ci.coupon_status IN (0, 1, 4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unusedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ci.coupon_status IN (3, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expiredCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ci.coupon_status = 2 THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS usedOrderAmount FROM t_coupon_template ct LEFT JOIN t_coupon_instance ci ON ci.template_id = ct.id AND ci.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_consume_order o ON ci.used_order_no = o.order_no AND o.order_status IN (1, 2) AND o.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ct.activity_id = #{activityId} AND ct.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ct.id, ct.coupon_name ORDER BY ct.id

SELECT m.level_code AS levelCode, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bul.benefit_type = 1 THEN bul.member_id END) AS participateCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bul.benefit_type = 2 THEN bul.member_id END) AS verifyCount, COALESCE(SUM(bul.order_amount), 0) AS orderAmount FROM t_benefit_use_log bul LEFT JOIN t_member m ON bul.member_id = m.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 WHERE bul.benefit_id = #{activityId} AND bul.use_status IN (1, 2) AND bul.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.level_code ORDER BY m.level_code

SELECT DATE(bul.create_time) AS statDate, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bul.benefit_type = 1 THEN bul.member_id END) AS newReceive, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bul.benefit_type = 2 THEN bul.member_id END) AS newVerify, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bul.order_no IS NOT NULL THEN bul.order_no END) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status IN (1, 2) THEN bul.order_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS orderAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_status = 3 THEN bul.order_no END) AS refundCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 3 THEN o.refund_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refundAmount FROM t_benefit_use_log bul LEFT JOIN t_consume_order o ON bul.order_no = o.order_no AND o.is_deleted = 0 WHERE bul.benefit_id = #{activityId} AND bul.use_status IN (1, 2) AND bul.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(bul.create_time) ORDER BY statDate ASC
